g.text: Edits from both apps: one ascent, three copies
For every synced record Boardsesh keeps the copy both apps last agreed on, and compares each app's copy with it.
(a) Different fields changed: both changes are kept
(b) The same field changed in both apps: Boardsesh keeps both values and asks the climber
Boardsesh never picks by clock time: a phone with a wrong clock would let an old edit replace a new one.
(c) An edit in one app, a delete in the other: the edit is kept, so nothing is lost
Each case works the same way with the two apps swapped.
Pushing an edit: it names the version it changes
The version is a version number, or the "updated at" time
Boardsesh last saw. If the API cannot check the version for
a kind of record, Boardsesh does not push edits of that kind.
